Calling cancel(order) by the maker marks that orderHash as cancelled (cancelledOrders[orderHash] == true) and does not change the contract's ETH balance.
If the order.maker (caller) calls cancel(order) successfully (no revert), then cancelledOrders[orderHash] becomes true.
If cancel(order) is called by order.maker and does not revert, then cancelledOrders[orderHash] is true.
If this contract (InvMutTest) is the maker and successfully calls cancel(order) (i.e., call does not revert), then c.cancelledOrders(hashOrder(order)) must be true.
